decisions.server108: Profile and reduce per-document analysis cost; keep the original fixture and the 180 s budget; cached reuse only for open warm documents. The Salsa-published fixture change (measured 368-377 s) is not applied.
decisions.source_order_entry_script: Assume a sourced file is not also an entry script, except files with a `#!` line or that read argv0 (those prove nothing). Stated in the contract (SourceOrderPremises UnlessMarked).
decisions.source_order_working_directory: Anchored paths only: an absolute path or [file join [file dirname [info script]] ...] proves order; a relative literal `source` proves nothing. The both_tiers loader fixture is written in the anchored form.
decisions.source_order_symlink: Recorded 07:40Z: accept 'a loader is invoked at its indexed path' as part of the Anchored premise; [file dirname [info script]] anchored paths keep proving order (a symlinked invocation from another directory is outside the premise).
decisions.source_order_anchor_configuration: Recorded 07:50Z (user in chat): anchor source-order resolution on tcl-lsp's configuration — the standard Tcl path environment (TCLLIBPATH) and configured libraryPaths — and let the user define entry-point scripts. The existing `[project] entryPoints` setting in .tcl-lsp.ini names the entry scripts: when set, only listed files are entries (the #!/argv0 heuristic applies only when it is unset), and the order proof starts from those entries. Path resolution for proof uses the same configured resolver as package/source resolution, not the loader directory.
